milestone: Imported and simulated pilot recordkeeping; live service adapter remains deferred.

cases.expected: An explicit bounded pilot phase retains exact current assessment, planning, scientific input and rule references, feasibility prerequisites, protocol draft and independent review.
Missing usable comparator or baseline data prevents a damage-evaluation-capable label and remains an explicit prerequisite.
Unsupported supplied precision or outcome timing yields a conditional or delivery/exposure/feasibility-limited pilot; no universal power estimate is invented.
Server registration time remains actual local retention time. Late or unknown outcome-access timing cannot gain a prespecified-target label through an earlier external date.
An amendment retains the original immutable protocol and analysis, declared outcome availability and affected fields; outcome-aware target/comparator changes remain exploratory.
New arithmetic, a new review or a programme target revision cannot restore prespecification for an already observed outcome.

Receipts bind exact action ID/version, permitted action, rule/version, operating scope, trigger references and confirmation level. Missing, duplicate or mismatched evidence cannot inflate confirmed delivery.
Failed and unknown outcomes remain visible. Reconciliation appends evidence to the original action; no automatic replay or new agent run occurs.
Simulated actions never become live delivery; human reports cannot replace service confirmation or establish adherence, exposure or damage reduction.
Independent verification identifies exact covered actions. Partial coverage and material deviations remain explicit and cannot imply all delivery was independently verified.

Supplied wrappers cannot promote synthetic raw receipts, rule proofs or external registration metadata. Future or pre-action verification timestamps and a later missing proof cannot leave an earlier action independently verified.
Source holds, revoked grants, material input changes and exact-run binding affect current eligibility; all originals, amendments, actions and reviews reopen after restart.
Identity/mode isolation, idempotency, optimistic revisions, rollback, one-active-phase limits and existing programme/run budgets apply to the new pilot phase and records.
